title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The prior preflight stopped before lock acquisition because a saved dependency manifest metadata hash changed. Source-only provenance inspection found that the current manifest points to another review consumer and was written during its conditional restore. Other saved dependency metadata, installed package versions, triplet and recorded ABIs still match. This supports manifest-path bookkeeping rather than a detected dependency change, but the old manifest JSON was not retained, so its exact prior field value cannot be verified from the old hash alone. Reuse requires an explicitly authorized successor guard pinning the current manifest identity and unchanged dependency inputs, with manifest installation disabled. No new restore, build, discovery or test has run; compilation and runtime gates remain unfinished.
